identity.title: Qualify OrientedBox3D contracts and pointer interactions

origin.summary: The owner approved the next ranked dependency-ready item. M-12 remained New although OrientedBox3D schema, geometry validation, numeric authoring, and actual pointer smoke already existed; the exact OrientedBox subset had no Runner-owned completeness gate and current runtime evidence was historical.

state.current_summary: M-12 remains resolved after terminal repository, inventory, contract, repeated runtime, documentation, issue-ledger, and diff-hygiene validation passed.

objective.summary: Close M-12 with one reusable OrientedBox3D qualification path covering schema round-trip, fail-closed geometry, actual pointer gestures, and Runner/CI completeness.
constraints: Keep ToolRecipeSelectionContractVerification as the sole schema and geometry assertion owner; add no duplicate verifier framework or geometry implementation.
Reuse the existing OrientedBox editor, Viewer handles, actual Windows pointer smoke, semantic theme, and Shell smoke routing without adding UI behavior or gestures.
Preserve selection identity, authored recipe state, Preview/Publish/Run separation, camera stability, and non-execution during pointer editing.
Exclude new downstream inspection consumers, SDK algorithms, schema-version movement, R0, and platform or hardware expansion.
Store generated local evidence physically under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab-3D-Studio.

criteria.text: The existing shared verifier proves valid schema 1.4/current-schema acceptance, exact rotated center/axes/half-extents save and reopen, old-schema rejection, and mixed-payload rejection.

The same shared verifier fails closed for zero-length, finite non-unit, parallel/non-orthogonal, left-handed, non-finite geometry, and non-positive half-extents without duplicating production geometry logic.

A Runner command reuses the shared verifier, requires every exact OrientedBox3D case, emits a stable complete marker, and the existing hosted contract step requires that marker and full report result.

Fresh current-build Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 actual Windows pointer smokes pass all seven Perspective/Top/Side gestures, accessible handles, camera stability, selection identity, no authored recipe or execution mutation, selected-monitor intersection, and contextual screenshot inspection.

Focused and full Release builds, affected selection/teaching/Viewer/Shell regressions, standard test facade, NuGet health, structure guard, fixed Vision SDK package guard, issue validation, documentation targets, repository JSON, inventory recount, and diff hygiene pass on the current tree.

context.summary: Owns current schema, persistence, invalid geometry, and selection payload checks.
Owns finite, positive, orthonormal, and right-handed validation reused by recipe, editor, and Viewer paths.
Owns seven actual Windows pointer gestures across Perspective, Top, and Side projections.

evidence.observation: The existing shared verifier remains the sole assertion owner and now requires the exact names of all 11 OrientedBox3D cases. It proves schema 1.4 and current-schema acceptance, exact rotated center/axes/half-extents save and reopen, schema 1.3 and mixed-payload rejection, and zero, finite non-unit, parallel/non-orthogonal, left-handed, non-finite, and non-positive geometry rejection through the production ToolRecipeOrientedBox3DGeometry validator. Any FAIL line, including fixture cleanup, fails the verifier.

Current Release reports pass shared selection 32/32 with OrientedBox3DContractVerification|PASS|cases=11|passed=11|failed=0, Inspection Workspace 67/67, Shell option routing 46/46, and Tool Recipe teaching 51/51. Runner OrientedBox/help exit 0, missing report exits 2 with exact usage, and source inspection confirms verifier failure exits 5. CI requires the Runner exit plus exact independent 11/11 and 32/32 report lines and retains exact Workbench authoring/round-trip and Shell routing gates; hosted Actions was not run locally.

The current Release Shell apphost passed two Compact 1280x760 and two Wide 1920x1040 repetitions. Every run completed seven actual Windows pointer gestures across Perspective, Top, and Side on its first routed-hover targeting attempt, exposed eight accessible handles per projection, preserved selection identity, authored and execution state, and camera, and passed normal, hover, pressed/released, mouse-leave, cursor, and status recovery. All four application-only screenshots passed quality on attempt 1 and intersected the dynamically selected smaller left DISPLAY2. Logical and physical bounds record the current 125% scaling; 100/150/175/200 were unrun.

Current-tree Release build passed all 15 projects with zero warnings and errors. Current reports pass Runner/shared 32/32 and exact OrientedBox 11/11, Workbench 67/67, Shell 46/46, teaching 51/51, standard tests 2/2, structure 68/68, NuGet health for 15 projects with vulnerable/deprecated 0/0, and the fixed OpenVisionLab.Vision3D 3.0.1-dev.20260823.crop.1 source commit and package SHA-256 guard.

All 66 Git-visible repository JSON files parsed, all 11 PL-0045 durable targets existed, the documentation index link resolved, the canonical 235-row inventory recounted to 150 C / 16 P / 44 N / 9 E / 16 O with exactly one M-12 Complete row, the next dependency-ready order was B-10 then E-13, and git diff --check exited 0.

Terminal verification passed: all 67 Git-visible JSON files parsed; the 235-row inventory was 150 C / 16 P / 44 N / 9 E / 16 O with M-12 Complete; PL-0045 was resolved with evidence on 5/5 criteria; all 45 issues validated; current contract totals and exact 11/11 marker remained present; two Compact and two Wide final runtime directories passed every first-attempt gesture, interaction state, screenshot-quality, and monitor-intersection gate; Release build, standard tests, structure, NuGet, fixed SDK, durable documentation, added-TODO search, and git diff --check all passed.
